comparison.objective: Join two studded blocks with exactly two adjacent studs engaged and lift the assembly; candidate breaks off already-installed insert tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Press-fit alignment and engagement followed by load-bearing lift versus coaxial mandrel placement, controlled impact, and loose-fragment retrieval.
comparison.success_condition: Two-stud overlap must retain the lower block during lift and release versus four fractured and recovered tangs with inserts fixed and no damage. Numeric fit thresholds are not included.
comparison.reason: Both involve small-part alignment, but they test different mechanisms and outcomes: reversible press-fit joining versus destructive notch finishing and containment.
